1.subject: The Hardest Lesson Most Men Need to Learn
1.body:
Welcome to Week 1.

This week lays the foundation for everything that follows.
And it starts with one of the hardest lessons most men will ever learn:
You cannot control her.
You cannot control how she feels.
How quickly she heals.
How she responds.
Or whether she notices your efforts right away.
But you can control how you show up.
And that's where real change begins.

This week, we'll focus on:
💌 Relinquishing control
💌 Understanding your Locus of Control
💌 Surrender and acceptance
💌 The Law of Detachment
💌 Why trying to prove you've changed often creates more distance
Most men begin this journey believing that if they explain themselves better...
Try harder...
Or show enough change...
Their wife will finally respond differently.
But the truth is, the more pressure you create, the more distance often follows.
Because growth isn't something you convince someone of.
It's something they experience over time.

This week, your goal is to shift from:
• Trying to control her responses
• Speeding up the process
• Proving your growth
And instead focus on:
• Owning your actions
• Letting go of what you can't control
• Showing up consistently without chasing an outcome

As you work through the material, pay close attention to the Locus of Control exercise.
It's one of the most important tools in this program.
Because it helps you stop wasting energy on things outside of your control and start focusing on the things that actually create change.

Throughout the week, notice when you feel the urge to:
• Defend yourself
• Explain your intentions
• Seek reassurance
• Get her to acknowledge your efforts

When that urge shows up, pause.
Take a breath.
And remind yourself:
Real change isn't something you prove.
It's something you practice.

Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Week 1 Workbook
• Complete the Locus of Control Exercise
• Practice letting go of the need to manage her reactions and focus on your own
Remember:
Surrender isn't giving up on your marriage.
It's giving up the need to control the outcome.
And trusting the process of your own growth.
Stay consistent this week.
The work you do here will shape everything that comes next.

With love,
RMM Team

2.subject: Becoming the Man You Want to Be
2.body:
Welcome to Week 2.

Last week, you learned to let go of control.
This week, we're going deeper.
Because lasting change doesn't come from learning the right thing to say.
Or finding the perfect way to get through to her.
It comes from changing the man behind the actions.
Most men focus on fixing the relationship.
But healthy relationships are built by healthy individuals.
And the more intentional you become, the more your relationship has the opportunity to change alongside you.

This week, we'll focus on:
💌 Understanding how your beliefs shape your behavior
💌 Moving from blame to personal leadership
💌 Creating more peace, presence, and purpose in your life
💌 Taking care of yourself so you're not running on empty
💌 Recognizing how past experiences may still be influencing your relationships today

As you work through this week's material, pay close attention to the Beliefs Worksheet.
Many of the thoughts, reactions, and patterns you struggle with today didn't begin in your marriage.
They often started years ago.
And until you become aware of them, they'll continue influencing how you show up.
Awareness is where change begins.

This week, notice when you're:
• Blaming circumstances instead of taking ownership
• Reacting instead of responding
• Neglecting your own well-being
• Acting from old fears, hurts, or assumptions
When you notice these patterns, don't judge yourself.
Simply pay attention.
Because you can't change what you don't recognize.
Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Week 2 Workbook
• Finish the Beliefs Worksheet
• Define the kind of husband and man you want to become
• Notice your patterns and reactions throughout the week
• Prioritize your physical and emotional well-being

Remember:
You cannot create a different relationship while remaining the same man.
The relationship changes when you change.
Not overnight.
But through small, consistent choices made day after day.
Stay intentional this week.
The man you're becoming is built by the actions you take today.
Next week, we'll focus on cleaning up your side of the street and breaking the patterns that keep relationships stuck.

With love,
RMM Team

3.subject: Clean Up Your Side of the Street
3.body:
Welcome to Week 3.

This is where things start to come together.
Over the last two weeks, you've worked on letting go of control.
You've started becoming more aware of how you're showing up.
Now it's time to take ownership of the patterns that may be keeping you stuck.

Because the goal isn't to fix your wife.
And it's not to fix your marriage overnight.
The goal is to clean up your side of the street.
That's where lasting change begins.

This week, you'll learn to recognize:
💌 Defensiveness and shutting down
💌 Over-explaining and trying to win
💌 Monitoring her moods and reactions
💌 The relationship patterns you've repeated over time
One of the most important exercises this week is identifying your patterns.

Because what you don't recognize...
You tend to repeat.
Many of the challenges you're facing today aren't happening because of one conversation or one mistake.
They're often the result of habits, reactions, and behaviors that have been playing out for years.
The good news?
Patterns can be changed.
But first, they have to be seen.
This week, you'll also begin creating a clear vision for the man you want to become and the marriage you want to build.
Because when you have clarity, it's easier to respond with purpose instead of reacting emotionally.

As you move through the week, notice when you're:
• Trying to defend yourself
• Explaining instead of listening
• Watching for her reactions instead of focusing on your own growth
• Falling back into familiar relationship habits

Don't beat yourself up when you notice these moments.
Just pay attention.
Awareness is the first step toward doing something different.

Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Week 3 Workbook
• Finish the Relationship Patterns Exercise
• Notice your "relationship killers" in real time
• Stop tracking her responses and focus on your own growth
• Create a clear vision for the future you want to build

Remember:
Awareness isn't about blame.
It's about freedom.
Because once you can see your patterns, you no longer have to live by them.
Stay committed to the process this week.
Next week, we'll build the communication skills that help your growth translate into real connection.

With love,
RMM Team

4.subject: Say Less, Say It Better
4.body:
Welcome to Week 4.

So far, you've spent time working on your mindset.
Your patterns.

And the way you've been showing up in your relationship.

This week, we're focusing on something that impacts every part of your marriage:
Communication.
Most men believe better communication means explaining more.
Defending themselves better.
Or finding the perfect words to get their point across.
But stronger communication rarely comes from saying more.
It comes from listening better.
Speaking with intention.
And knowing when to pause.
Because communication isn't about winning the argument.
It's about creating understanding.
Connection.
And trust.

This week, you'll learn:
💌 How to truly listen instead of reacting
💌 When to take a break before conflict escalates
💌 The difference between criticism and making a clear request
💌 How to repair after a mistake
💌 Why unspoken expectations often create resentment

One of the biggest mistakes men make is focusing on being understood before understanding.
But when people feel heard, conversations change.
Defensiveness decreases.
And connection becomes possible.

As you move through this week, notice when you feel the urge to:
• Interrupt
• Defend yourself
• Explain your intentions
• Prove your point

When those moments arise, pause.
Take a breath.

And focus on understanding before being understood.
Because how you communicate matters just as much as what you communicate.

Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Week 4 Workbook
• Practice listening without interrupting or fixing
• Pause when conversations become heated
• Turn one criticism into a clear request
• Notice where you have unspoken expectations

Remember:
Better communication isn't about saying more.
It's about saying what matters.
At the right time.
In the right way.
Stay intentional this week.
The communication skills you build now will strengthen every step you take moving forward.

Next week, we'll work through resentment and forgiveness so you can stop carrying what no longer serves you.

With love,
RMM Team

5.subject: Letting Go of What You're Carrying
5.body:
Welcome to Week 5.

This week, we're talking about something that quietly damages more relationships than most people realize:
Resentment.
The truth is, unresolved hurt doesn't simply disappear with time.
It stays beneath the surface.
Showing up in your patience.
Your reactions.
The way you speak to your wife.
And the way you connect with her.
When disappointment, frustration, and unmet expectations go unaddressed, they create distance.
Even when you're trying to move forward.
That's why this week is so important.
Because healing isn't just about learning new skills.
It's also about letting go of the things that are weighing you down.

This week, you'll explore:
💌 Where resentment has built up in your relationship
💌 The expectations and hurts beneath it
💌 How forgiveness helps you move forward
💌 How unresolved emotions show up in everyday interactions

Many men carry resentment without fully realizing it.
They tell themselves they're over it.
That it happened a long time ago.
Or that it shouldn't affect them anymore.
But what remains unhealed often continues to influence how you show up today.
Forgiveness doesn't mean what happened was okay.
And it doesn't mean you excuse the pain.
It means you're choosing not to let the past continue controlling your present.
As you move through this week, notice where you find yourself:
• Replaying old hurts
• Holding onto disappointment
• Keeping score
• Reacting to the past instead of responding to the present
When those moments arise, approach them with honesty.
Not judgment.
Because awareness is what creates the opportunity to heal.

Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Week 5 Workbook
• Work through the Resentment Worksheet
• Complete the Forgiveness Meditation
• Notice where resentment is showing up in your daily interactions

Remember:
The things you refuse to release often become the things that continue to weigh you down.
Healing begins when you're willing to face what you've been carrying.
And that's exactly what you'll begin doing this week.
Stay committed to the process.

Next week, we'll focus on leadership and how your actions help create the relationship you're working toward.

With love,
RMM Team

6.subject: What she needs might not be what she says
6.body:
Welcome to Week 6.

This week is about leadership.
Not control.
Not dominance.
And not having all the answers.
Real leadership starts with learning to lead yourself well.
Because the way you think, act, and respond sets the tone for every relationship in your life.
Especially your marriage.

Many men believe leadership is about telling people what to do.
But healthy leadership looks very different.
It's steady.
Grounded.
Consistent.
And it shows up most when life feels uncertain.

This week, you'll learn:
💌 What healthy masculine leadership actually looks like
💌 How to become more decisive and intentional
💌 Why self-respect shapes your relationships
💌 The difference between complaints and clearly communicating your needs
💌 How stillness and mental clarity help you stay grounded

One of the biggest shifts you'll make this week is realizing that leadership isn't about changing other people.
It's about taking responsibility for yourself.
Your mindset.
Your actions.
And the standards you choose to live by.

As you move through the week, notice where you're:
• Avoiding decisions
• Looking to others for validation
• Complaining instead of communicating clearly
• Acting in ways that don't align with your values

When those moments arise, don't judge yourself.
Just pay attention.
Because leadership begins with awareness.
And grows through consistent action.

Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Week 6 Workbook
• Practice making clear decisions
• Notice where you lose self-respect and make adjustments
• Turn one complaint into a clear need
• Complete the practices and meditations

Remember:
Leadership isn't something you tell people about.
It's something they experience through your actions.
The more consistently you show up as the man you want to be, the more your relationships begin to reflect that change.
Stay committed to the process this week.

Next week, we'll focus on understanding her more deeply and creating emotional safety in your relationship.

With love,
RMM Team

7.subject: Understanding Her Without Losing Yourself
7.body:
Welcome to Week 7.

Up until now, the focus has been on you.
Your mindset.
Your habits.
Your leadership.
And the way you've been showing up in your relationship.
This week, we're expanding that focus.
Not to fix her.
Not to manage her emotions.
But to better understand what's happening so you can respond in a way that creates connection instead of distance.

Many men believe that when their wife is upset, they need to solve the problem.
Fix the emotion.
Or defend themselves.
But most of the time, those reactions create even more disconnection.
Because what people often need most in difficult moments isn't a solution.
It's to feel heard.
Understood.
And safe.
This week, you'll learn:
💌 What emotional safety actually looks like
💌 How to stay present when she is upset
💌 Why listening matters more than fixing
💌 How your reactions either create connection or distance
💌 How to stay grounded during emotional moments
One of the biggest shifts you'll make this week is learning that safety is not the same thing as agreement.
You don't have to agree with everything she says.
You don't have to have the perfect response.
And you don't have to fix every emotion.
What matters is your ability to stay calm.
Present.
And open when things aren't calm.
As you move through the week, notice when you feel the urge to:
• Fix the situation immediately
• Defend yourself
• Explain your intentions
• Shut down or withdraw
When those moments arise, pause.
Focus on staying present before trying to change the conversation.
Because your presence often matters more than your words.
Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Week 7 Workbook
• Practice staying present when she is emotional
• Listen without fixing, interrupting, or defending
• Notice your automatic reactions (shutdown, urgency, defensiveness)
• Focus on your tone, body language, and presence
Remember:
You do not need the perfect response.
You need a steady one.
Because steadiness creates safety.
And safety creates connection.
Stay committed to the process this week.
Next week, we'll build on this foundation by strengthening appreciation, respect, and emotional connection.

With love,
RMM Team

8.subject: What You Reinforce Grows
8.body:
Welcome to Week 8.
This week is about something simple.
But incredibly powerful.
Appreciation.
And admiration.
These are two things that often get overlooked in relationships.
Not because they don't matter.
But because most people become focused on what's missing.
What's frustrating.
Or what still needs to change.
Over time, whatever you focus on becomes the emotional tone of the relationship.
And that's why this week's work matters so much.
The goal is to shift from:
• Noticing problems to noticing what's working
• Holding back appreciation to expressing it directly
• Assuming she knows to actually saying it
Because appreciation doesn't have to be big.
Or complicated.
It just needs to be genuine.
Specific.
And consistent.
Simple things like:
• "I appreciate how you handled that."
• "I noticed that, and I really value it."
• "I like how you showed up there."

Small moments matter more than you think.
This week, we'll also talk about admiration.
Because appreciation is about what someone does.
Admiration is about who they are.
It's recognizing qualities, strengths, and character.
When a woman feels seen and appreciated, connection tends to grow.
When she doesn't, distance often follows.
This week is also an opportunity to practice gratitude.
Not as a way of ignoring problems.
But as a way of training yourself to notice more than just what's wrong.
Because what you consistently focus on shapes how you experience your relationship.

As you move through the week, notice:
• What you're paying attention to
• How often you express appreciation
• Whether you're focusing more on problems or positives
• The qualities you genuinely admire in her
Your assignments this week:
• Express one genuine appreciation every day
• Notice what you're focusing on (problems vs. positives)
• Say one thing you genuinely admire about her out loud

Remember:
What you reinforce grows.
The things you consistently acknowledge tend to become stronger.

And the things you continually focus on often shape the direction of your relationship.
Stay intentional this week.

Next week, we'll focus on direction and intentional goal setting so you can begin building your relationship with purpose instead of reaction.

With love,
RMM Team

9.subject: Get Clear on Where You're Going
9.body:
Welcome to Week 9.

Up until now, you've been doing the internal work.
You've worked on your mindset.
Your habits.
Your reactions.
And the way you show up in your relationship.
This week, we shift into something equally important:
Direction.

Because without clarity on where you're going, it's easy to fall back into old patterns.
To react instead of lead.
To drift instead of build.
Many men spend their lives responding to problems as they arise.
Putting out fires.
Managing what's urgent.
And hoping things eventually improve.
But growth rarely happens by accident.
It happens when you're intentional about where you're headed.
That's what this week is about.
Getting clear on what matters most.

This week, you'll use the Circle of Life to look at the bigger picture:
💌 Your relationship
💌 Your health
💌 Your career
💌 Your personal growth
💌 Your finances
💌 Your environment

Because your relationship doesn't exist in isolation.
When one area of your life is struggling, it often affects everything else.
And when you strengthen one area, it often creates positive momentum across the board.

You'll also begin defining your direction by asking yourself:
• What kind of relationship am I building?
• What kind of man am I becoming?
• What deserves my focus right now?
The goal isn't to have every detail figured out.
You don't need a perfect plan.
You simply need clarity on what's most important.
Because clarity helps you stop reacting and start moving with purpose.

As you move through this week, notice:
• Where you're drifting instead of leading
• What areas of life need more attention
• Where your actions align with your goals
• What small changes could create meaningful momentum

Your assignments this week:
• Complete the Circle of Life Exercise
• Identify your top focus areas
• Set 2–3 simple goals
• Take one small action toward each goal

Remember:
Clarity creates direction.
Direction creates momentum.
And momentum creates change.
Stay intentional this week.

Next week, we'll focus on intimacy and rebuilding deeper connection in your relationship.

With love,
RMM Team

10.subject: Rebuilding Intimacy and Connection
10.body:
Welcome to Week 10.

This week we focus on intimacy.

Intimacy is not just physical—it is emotional connection, safety, and how close both people feel in the relationship.
A common mistake is focusing only on the physical side while ignoring the emotional environment that creates it.

Intimacy actually starts outside the bedroom:
• Presence vs distraction
• Connection vs withdrawal
• Safety vs pressure
What you do day to day shapes closeness over time.
This week, you'll look at:
• Your patterns around intimacy
• How you respond to distance or rejection
• Where pressure or expectation shows up
• Your tendency to shut down or pull away
The key is awareness. Most reactions in this area are driven by deeper emotional patterns, not the moment itself.
When things don't go how you want, notice your reaction:
• Do you shut down?
• Get frustrated?
• Pull away?

These reactions create more distance. Learning to stay grounded changes the dynamic.
This week is not about fixing anything or forcing change. It is about removing pressure so connection can rebuild naturally.

Your work this week:
• Go through the intimacy material
• Notice your emotional reactions (pressure, frustration, withdrawal)
• Focus on being present outside of intimacy
• Remove pressure or expectation for outcomes
One thing to remember: intimacy is built, not demanded.

Next week, we focus on trust, healing, and rebuilding after rupture.

11.subject: Trust, Betrayal, and What Comes Next
11.body:
Welcome to Week 11.

This is one of the most difficult weeks in the process—trust, betrayal, and infidelity.

If this is part of your story, you already know how heavy it feels.
Before anything else: betrayal is painful, disorienting, and not something you caused alone.
At the same time, in many cases it reflects deeper relationship issues—not to excuse it, but to understand what needs to change moving forward.
This week is about clarity, not confusion or blame.
You'll look at:
• Why infidelity can happen in relationships
• Limerence and emotional intensity
• What's required to rebuild trust
• How to handle things if you are currently in it
Trust is not rebuilt through words. It is rebuilt through consistent actions over time—small behaviors, follow-through, and emotional steadiness.
Trying to rush it only adds pressure.
What matters now is how you show up:
• Are you grounded or reactive?
• Focused on growth or stuck in the past?
• Responding or trying to control outcomes?
If betrayal is present, there is no quick fix. Only:
• Honesty
• Boundaries
• Consistency
• Time
And effort from both people.
Your work this week:
• Go through all Week 11 lessons
• Notice emotional reactions (anger, shutdown, control)
• Focus only on what you can control
• Stay consistent in your actions and responses

One thing to remember: you don't force trust back—you become the kind of man where trust can exist again.
Next week, we bring everything together and focus on rebuilding the relationship moving forward.

12.subject: Building What Comes Next
12.body:
Welcome to Week 12.

You made it to the final week.
Most men don't stay consistent long enough to actually change how they show up—you did.

This week is about what comes next.
This is not the end. It's the transition from learning to living it.

Everything you've worked on:
• Letting go of control
• Taking ownership
• Cleaning up your patterns
• Improving communication
• Leading yourself
• Creating connection

This is now your baseline—not something you visit, but how you live.

You are not going back to the old version of your relationship. You are building something new.

Relationship 2.0 means:
• You own your side
• You communicate clearly
• You stay steady under pressure
• You create connection instead of chasing it

A strong relationship is not one person doing everything. It's two people contributing.
But your job is not to wait—it's to keep showing up consistently as the man you've become.

Moving forward:
• Stay aware of your patterns
• Communicate clearly and directly
• Lead yourself first
• Keep appreciation and connection active
• Stay aligned with your vision
You will slip at times. That's normal.

When it happens:
• Don't spiral

With Love,
RMM Team

1.subject: Starting where you actually are
1.body:
Hey {{contact.first_name}},

Welcome.
Before anything else, I want you to take a breath and just acknowledge that you're here.
You made a decision to step into this work, and that matters.
This first week isn't about changing everything overnight.
It's about getting honest about where you are right now.
Your patterns.
Your relationships.
What's been working… and what hasn't.
No fixing yet. Just seeing it clearly.
A lot of what we're focusing on this week is acceptance.
Not in a "this is just how it is, nothing will change" way…
but in a grounded, honest way.
Because real change only happens when you stop fighting reality and actually look at it.
You'll go through things like:
- Letting go of control

- Looking at outside influences and opinions

- Taking responsibility for your role

- Understanding your patterns and timeline

Some of this might feel uncomfortable.
That's normal.
Most of us are used to either avoiding this or trying to jump straight to solutions.
This week slows that down.
What I want you to focus on:
Go through the content, but don't rush it.
- Complete the Week 1 workbook

- Write your commitment letter and take it seriously

- Pay attention to where you're holding on tightly or trying to control outcomes

- Notice where you've been giving your power away

And be honest with yourself as you do it. That's where the value is.
You might catch yourself thinking:
"I already know this"
or
"I just want to get to the next part"
Stay here.
This foundation matters more than you think.
Also, stay connected this week.
Come to the calls.
Share in the group.
Let yourself be seen a little, even if it feels unfamiliar.
You're not meant to do this in your head alone.
If you do this week fully, you'll start to see things more clearly.
And that clarity is what everything else builds on.
We're just getting started.

2.subject: This is where things start to shift
2.body:
Alright, welcome to Week 2.
This is where we start getting into the stuff that actually drives your relationships… even if you don't always see it.
We're looking at your self-beliefs, how you treat yourself, and the patterns you've been carrying into relationships.
Not in a surface-level way, but in a real, honest way.
Because the truth is, how you feel about yourself shows up everywhere.
It shows up in what you tolerate, how you communicate, how you react, and what you believe you deserve.
This week isn't about "fixing" anything yet.
It's about noticing.
A lot of you already know some of this… but there's a difference between knowing it and actually seeing it in your own life.
That's what we're doing here.
Here's what I want you focused on:
Go through the material, but more importantly, slow down enough to actually reflect as you do it.
- Do the Self Beliefs worksheet and be honest, not ideal

- Use the Emotion Wheel when you feel triggered or off instead of brushing it off

- Start using the Self Care Planner like it actually matters (because it does)

- Take your time with the Relationship Patterns exercise — this one tends to open a lot up

If you rush this, you'll miss the point.
You might notice some resistance this week.
That can look like:
"I already know this"
"I'll come back to it later"
or just not fully engaging with it
That's normal.
Just don't let that be the reason you stay in the same patterns.
Also, stay connected.
Come to the calls, share in the group, ask questions, let yourself be seen a bit.
This work goes a lot further when you're not doing it in your own head.
If you take this week seriously, you'll start to notice things you didn't fully see before.
How you talk to yourself.
Where you override your needs.
The patterns that keep repeating.
And that awareness is what everything else builds on.
Go all in on this week. Don't half do it.

I'll see you on the calls,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

3.subject: Allowing yourself to want more
3.body:
Welcome to Week 3.
By now, you've started to look at yourself a little more honestly.
Your patterns, your habits, the way you've been showing up.
And for a lot of people, this is where something begins to open… even if it's subtle.
This week, we're turning toward something new.
Not just what's been happening,
but what you actually want moving forward.
Your vision.
Your future.
The version of you you're stepping into.
For some of you, this will feel exciting.
For others, it might feel a little unclear… or even uncomfortable.
You might not be used to slowing down and asking yourself what you really want.
Or trusting what comes up.
That's okay.  There's nothing you need to force here.  The intention this week is to start creating clarity, gently.
As you move through the module:

Take your time with the workbook and let yourself really reflect

Be present with the meditations (these are important, not optional background noise)

Let the contrast of what hasn't worked help you see what you do want
Try not to rush to an answer. Let it unfold a bit.
And just like the past weeks, this only works if you stay engaged.
Come to the calls.
Share in the group.
Let yourself be seen, even if what you're sharing feels incomplete.
That's where a lot of the clarity comes from.
If you give yourself space to actually do this work, you may notice:

A clearer sense of direction
A deeper connection to what you want
And a shift in how you start thinking about your future
You don't need to have it all figured out.
Just be willing to explore it, and stay in the process.
Excited to hear what comes up for you this week,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

4.subject: Taking a deeper look at your role
4.body:
Welcome to Week 4.
By now, you've started to build awareness around yourself…
how you think, how you feel, and how you show up.
This week, we take that one step further.
We start looking at your role in your relationships.
This isn't about blame.
It's not about making yourself wrong or taking responsibility for things that weren't yours.
It's about gently and honestly asking:
Where have I contributed to the patterns I say I don't want?
This can be a tender week.
You might notice moments of defensiveness, or the urge to focus on what the other person did.
That's normal.
Just see if you can stay with yourself in it.
As you move through this week:
Take your time with the material. This isn't one to rush.
- Go all in on the workbook and actually reflect, not just answer quickly

- Move slowly through the lessons around relationship patterns, resentment, and repair

- Pay attention to where you've been holding onto things or avoiding honest communication

- Let yourself really understand what it means to "clean your side of the street"

This work has a lot of depth to it if you let it.
Also, stay connected.
Come to the calls.
Share what's coming up, even if it feels a little uncomfortable to say out loud.
You're not the only one working through this.
If you allow yourself to be honest this week, you may start to see:
Where you've had more power than you realized
Where you've been protecting yourself in ways that no longer serve you
And what it might look like to show up differently
There's no need to get it perfect.
Just stay open, and stay with the process.

I'm here with you in this,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

5.subject: Letting Go of what you have been carrying
5.body:
Welcome to Week 5.
This week tends to bring things a little closer to the surface.
We're moving into resentment, forgiveness, and the emotions that often sit underneath both.
A lot of what we carry in relationships isn't always obvious.
It builds over time.
Unspoken feelings, past experiences, things that didn't feel resolved.
And even when we think we've moved on… those things can still shape how we show up.
This week is about gently starting to release some of that.
Not by forcing yourself to "just forgive,"
but by actually understanding what's there first.
As you go through the material:
Give yourself space with this.
- Take your time with the workbook — this is one to really sit with

- Move through the resentment work honestly, even if it brings things up

- Be present with the forgiveness and inner child practices

- Notice what emotions come up, rather than pushing them away

There's no rush here.
You might feel more emotional than usual this week.
That's okay.
It doesn't mean anything is going wrong.
It usually means you're actually allowing yourself to feel something that's been there for a while.
Stay connected as you move through this.
Come to the calls.
Share in the group if you feel comfortable.
You don't have to carry this alone.
If you stay with this work, even gently, you may notice:
A little more space in yourself
A little less emotional weight
And a different relationship to things that used to feel heavy
Be patient with yourself this week.
You're doing deeper work now.

Take it one step at a time,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

6.subject: How you communicate changes everything
6.body:
Welcome to Week 6.
Up until now, most of the work has been internal.
Your awareness, your patterns, your emotions.
This week, we start bringing that into how you actually show up with others.
Because no matter how much awareness you have…
If it's not reflected in how you communicate, your relationships won't change.
This week is about learning a different way to communicate.
More clearly.
More honestly.
And without falling into the same patterns.
You'll be working with tools like:
- Active listening

- Non-violent communication

- Boundaries

- The feedback wheel

And while these might seem simple, they take practice.
Your work this week:
This is a "practice in real life" kind of week.
- Go through the lessons and workbook slowly

- Pay attention to how you usually communicate, especially in moments of tension

- Start applying what you're learning in small, real interactions

- Notice when you fall back into old patterns (that awareness matters)

You don't have to get it perfect.
Just start catching it and trying something different.
You might notice this week brings up frustration.
Communication is where patterns tend to show up quickly.
That's okay.
It doesn't mean you're doing it wrong.
It means you're seeing it more clearly.
Also, stay connected.
Come to the calls.
Bring real situations you're navigating.
Share what's working and what's not.
This is where a lot of the learning clicks.
If you stay engaged this week, you may start to notice:
More clarity in your conversations
Less reactivity
And a different kind of confidence in how you express yourself
Take it one conversation at a time.
You're learning a new way of showing up.

Keep practicing,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

7.subject: Stepping into your Queen Energy
7.body:
Welcome to Week 7.
Up until now, you've done a lot of deeper work…
understanding your patterns, your emotions, and how you've been showing up.
This week is a shift.
It's not about fixing anything.
It's about stepping into a different version of yourself.
We're focusing on your feminine energy.
And at the core of that is something simple, but often overlooked:
Your desires.
What you want.
What you feel.
What you need.
For a lot of women, this doesn't come naturally at first.
You may be used to:
- thinking about what others need

- staying in control

- or second-guessing what you feel

So if this feels unfamiliar, that's okay.
This is where you start reconnecting.
A big part of stepping into your "queen" energy is learning to trust yourself again.
And that starts with awareness in real time.
Throughout your day, come back to yourself and ask:
How do I feel right now?
What do I want?
What do I need?
Not once… but consistently.
Your work this week:
Stay gentle with yourself, but stay engaged.
- Complete the journal exercise and list out 20 desires

- Check in with yourself throughout the day (this is where the real shift happens)

- Notice where you override your feelings or needs

- Allow yourself to feel what you feel, without shutting it down

Don't overthink your answers. Let them be honest.
There's also a layer of vulnerability here.
Stepping into this energy isn't about being perfect or having it all together.
It's about allowing yourself to be seen… even when you're still figuring things out.
That can feel uncomfortable.
Just take it one step at a time.
Stay connected this week.
Come to the calls.
Share what you're noticing.
Let yourself be witnessed a little more than you normally would.
If you stay with this work, you may begin to notice:
A stronger connection to yourself
More clarity around what you actually want
And a shift in how you show up… without forcing it
You don't have to chase this version of you.
You just have to keep coming back to yourself.

Step into it in your own way,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

8.subject: Understanding how he operates
8.body:
Welcome to Week 8.
This week, we start looking at something that can bring a lot of clarity into your relationships.
How masculine energy operates.
Up until now, a lot of the focus has been on you…
your patterns, your communication, your emotional world.
This week expands that.
Because one of the biggest sources of frustration in relationships is expecting someone to think, feel, or respond the way you would.
Men are not women.
And they're not meant to be.
This isn't about making one way right or wrong.
It's about understanding the differences so you're not constantly feeling confused, disappointed, or disconnected.
As you move through this week:
Stay open.
Some of this may challenge the way you've been interpreting things.
- Go through the lessons and workbook slowly

- Pay attention to the characteristics and drives of masculine energy

- Notice where you may have been expecting him to show up in a way that doesn't align with how he's wired

- Let this be about understanding, not judging

You may have moments where things start to "click."
Where you see past situations differently.
Where something that felt personal… starts to make more sense.
At the same time, this isn't about dismissing your needs.
It's about learning how to meet each other with more awareness.
Stay connected this week.
Come to the calls.
Share what you're noticing.
Ask questions when something doesn't fully land yet.
If you stay open to this, you may begin to notice:
Less confusion
Less personalization
And more clarity in how you relate to men

Take what resonates, and let yourself learn something new.

You don't have to force it,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

9.subject: Rebuilding Trust with yourself and others
9.body:
Welcome to Week 9.
This week, we're moving into a more tender and complex topic.
Infidelity and trust.
This can bring up a lot.
For some of you, it may connect to personal experiences.
For others, it may bring up fears, questions, or things you've never fully processed.
Whatever comes up for you… just notice it.
There's nothing you need to push away or rush through.
This week isn't just about what happens in a relationship.
It's also about your relationship with trust itself.
Trust in others…
and trust in yourself.
As you go through the material:
Move gently, but stay present.
- Take your time with the workbook and be honest with what's there

- Go through the lessons around infidelity, limerence, and trust with an open mind

- Notice your emotional responses without judging them

- Allow yourself space to process, rather than trying to immediately "figure it out"

You might feel more emotional this week.
That's okay.
It doesn't mean anything is wrong.
It usually means something important is being acknowledged.
Stay connected.
Come to the calls.
Share if and when you feel ready.
Listen to others if that feels more supportive.
There's a lot of healing that happens in simply not being alone in it.
If you stay with this work, you may begin to notice:
A deeper understanding of trust
More awareness around your own boundaries and needs
And a shift in how you hold past or current experiences
Go gently with yourself this week.
There's no timeline for this kind of work.
You might find that this week brings up a deeper awareness around trust, patterns, and what you want moving forward.
For some of you, this is also the point where you start thinking about what's next.
If you're feeling that… you're not alone.
There is a next level of this work where we go deeper into feminine energy, self-trust, and how you show up in relationships in a more embodied, powerful way.  This is where women really step into their voice, their standards, and how they show up in relationships
If that's something you're curious about, you can book a call with us to explore it.
No pressure, just a conversation to see what feels aligned for you.
https://calendly.com/luann-sophieorozco/clarity-call-with-luann

Just stay present with it,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

10.subject: Shifting what you focus on
10.body:
Welcome to Week 10.
After the depth of the past couple of weeks, this one is a bit of a shift.
We're focusing on appreciation, gratitude, and what happens when you intentionally start noticing what's working.
Where your attention goes, your experience tends to follow.
And in relationships, it's very easy to focus on what's missing, what's frustrating, or what isn't being done the way you'd like.
This week is about gently shifting that.
Not by ignoring real issues…
But by creating more balance in what you're seeing and expressing.
Your focus this week:
Keep it simple, but consistent.
- Each day, write down 3 things you feel grateful for about your partner

- Express at least one of them directly using:
"I really appreciated you… it made me feel…"

You can do this:
- In a text

- On a call

- In person

- Or with a written note

What matters is that it's genuine.
We're also expanding this beyond just your partner.
- Get a pack of thank you cards

- Write 1–3 each week to people who have supported you

- Let them know how and why their presence has made your life better

This isn't just about them.
It shifts something in you when you take the time to acknowledge it.
As you move through the week, notice:
How it feels to express appreciation
What changes in your interactions
And what happens when you actively look for the good
If this feels unfamiliar or even a little uncomfortable at first, that's okay.
You're practicing something new.
Stay connected this week.
Come to the calls.
Share what you're noticing, even the small shifts.
They matter more than you think.
If you stay consistent with this, you may begin to notice:
More softness in your relationships
More connection
And a different emotional tone overall
Keep it simple, and stay with it.

Excited to hear what you notice this week,
Sophie Orozco Coaching

11.subject: Letting yourself be closer
11.body:
This week is a different kind of work.
Not heavier. Not necessarily harder.
Just… closer.
When most people hear "intimacy," they think about physical connection.
But real intimacy starts somewhere else.
It starts in how safe you feel being seen.
How open you're willing to be.
How much of yourself you actually let someone experience.
And that's not always easy.
Even if you want connection, there can still be moments where you pull back a little.
Where you filter what you say.
Where you stay guarded without fully realizing it.
This week is about noticing that.
Not forcing anything. Just becoming aware of where you let people in… and where you don't.
As you move through the material, don't rush it.
Let it land where it lands.
Pay attention to:
- where you feel open

- where you close off

- what feels safe… and what doesn't

There's a lot of information in that.
And when it comes to your relationship, see if you can take one small step toward more openness.
Not everything all at once.
Just a little more honesty.
A little more presence.
A little less holding back.
You don't need to perform intimacy.
You just have to allow it.
Stay close to the process this week.
Come to the calls.
Share if it feels right.
Or just listen and take it in.
Both matter.
There's no perfect way to do this.
Just a willingness to soften where you can.
That's enough.

12.subject: Taking this with you
12.body:
You made it to Week 12.
Before anything else, take a moment and really acknowledge that.
You showed up for this work.
You stayed with it.
And you allowed yourself to see things differently.
That's not small.
Over the past weeks, you've built something real.
Not just ideas… but awareness.
You've started to notice your patterns in real time.
You've practiced communicating differently.
You've reconnected with yourself in a deeper way.
And even if it doesn't feel dramatic, something has shifted.
This week isn't about adding more.
It's about taking in what's already changed.
As you move through this final module, give yourself a little space to reflect.
Where were you when you started?
What feels different now?
What are you no longer willing to ignore?
Let those answers be honest.
And just as important…
What do you want to keep choosing moving forward?
Because this work doesn't end here.
This is where it becomes something you live.
Some of you may feel complete with this chapter.
And some of you may feel like you're just getting started.
Like there's more of you that wants to come forward.
More depth. More embodiment. More alignment.
If that's you, I want you to know there is a next step.
Inside the Radiant Feminine Blueprint, we go deeper into this work.
Into your feminine energy, your self-trust, your standards, and how you show up in relationships in a more embodied, powerful way.
If that feels aligned, you're invited to book a call with us and explore it.
No pressure, just a conversation to see what feels right for you.
https://calendly.com/luann-sophieorozco/clarity-call-with-luann
Either way, what you've done here matters.
And what you do with it moving forward matters even more.
Keep coming back to yourself.
Keep choosing awareness.
Keep showing up in a way that feels true to you.
You don't need to do it perfectly.
Just don't go back to being disconnected from yourself.
I'm really glad you were part of this.
